title: Weeknight Kitchen - easy and special-occasion recipes
content: Recipes for two: Spanish omelette, stuffed peppers, mushroom risotto, chickpea curry, spaghetti with tomato sauce, jacket potatoes, steak with peppercorn sauce. Each page lists exact ingredients.

title: Spanish omelette - Weeknight Kitchen
content:
Spanish omelette. Serves 2. Vegetarian. Weeknight.

Ingredients:
- Potatoes 4
- Onion 1
- Eggs 6
- Olive oil
- Salt

Method: Slice and fry the potatoes and onion slowly, add the beaten eggs and cook through.

title: Stuffed peppers - Weeknight Kitchen
content:
Stuffed peppers. Serves 2. Vegetarian. Weeknight.

Ingredients:
- Red peppers 2
- Tinned chopped tomatoes 1
- Long-grain rice 150g
- Cheddar 100g
- Olive oil
- Salt

Method: Cook the rice with the tomatoes, fill the halved peppers, top with cheddar and bake.

title: Mushroom risotto - Weeknight Kitchen
content:
Mushroom risotto. Serves 2. Vegetarian. Special occasion.

Ingredients:
- Arborio rice 300g
- Chestnut mushrooms 400g
- Onion 1
- Vegetarian hard cheese 50g
- Vegetable stock cubes 2
- White wine 1 bottle (one glass for the risotto)
- Olive oil
- Salt

Method: Soften the onion, toast the rice, add wine then stock gradually, stir in mushrooms and cheese.

title: Chickpea curry - Weeknight Kitchen
content:
Chickpea curry. Serves 2. Vegetarian. Weeknight.

Ingredients:
- Onion 1
- Red pepper 1
- Tinned chopped tomatoes 1
- Tinned chickpeas 1
- Coconut milk 1 tin
- Long-grain rice 150g
- Curry powder

Method: Fry the onion and pepper, add spices, tomatoes, chickpeas and coconut milk; serve with rice.

title: Spaghetti with tomato sauce - Weeknight Kitchen
content:
Spaghetti with tomato sauce. Serves 2. Vegetarian. Weeknight.

Ingredients:
- Spaghetti 250g
- Tinned chopped tomatoes 2
- Onion 1
- Olive oil
- Salt

Method: Simmer the onion and tomatoes into a sauce and toss with the spaghetti.

title: Jacket potatoes with cheese and beans - Weeknight Kitchen
content:
Jacket potatoes with cheese and beans. Serves 2. Vegetarian. Weeknight.

Ingredients:
- Potatoes 2
- Cheddar 100g
- Baked beans 1 tin

Method: Bake the potatoes, top with beans and cheddar.

title: Steak with peppercorn sauce - Weeknight Kitchen
content:
Steak with peppercorn sauce. Serves 2. Special occasion. Contains meat.

Ingredients:
- Sirloin steaks 2
- Double cream 150ml
- Black peppercorns
- Potatoes 4
- Butter

Method: Sear the steaks, make a sauce with the cream and crushed peppercorns, serve with chips.
